name: Fivestars by SumUp (SumUp Connect)
oneLiner: Loyalty and automated marketing platform for local US businesses, acquired by SumUp in 2021 and now sold in the US as SumUp Connect, with the consumer app branded Fivestars by SumUp.
bestFor: Independent cafes, quick-service restaurants and other local businesses that want phone-number loyalty and automated texts with little daily effort.

updates.text: SumUp expanded its US product lineup (April 28, 2026) with the SumUp Terminal and new reporting and business-insight tools in the SumUp app, with loyalty offered alongside SumUp POS.

SumUp launched SumUp Loyalty (April 21, 2026) in the UK, France, Germany, Ireland, Spain and Italy: card-linked points or stamps through the SumUp Local app, with an Autopilot feature for inactive customers. Not a US launch.

features: Phone-number check-in on a customer-facing Fivestars/SumUp Connect device at checkout
Points-based loyalty with rewards redeemed at the register
AutoPilot automated SMS campaigns: welcome, birthday and win-back messages
Standard promotions sent to the customer list (2 per month on Connect Plus); unlimited AI-enhanced messaging on Connect Pro
Review Boost (Connect Pro): invites happy customers to leave a review and offers a reward for it
Customer directory with visit and spend history, plus performance insights
Fivestars by SumUp consumer app where members track points
Works with SumUp POS and with many third-party POS systems

pricing.text: SumUp publishes Connect pricing: Connect Plus $269/month and Connect Pro $349/month; with SumUp POS, POS with Connect Plus $199/month and POS with Connect Pro $289/month. 'No complicated contracts.' No trial or free plan listed. SumUp's 2024 launch release said packages start at $49/month, but that tier is not on the current pricing page.

notes: SumUp acquired Fivestars in October 2021 (reported at $317M). SumUp Connect launched in the US in May 2024 (https://www.sumup.com/en-us/press/connect-launch/) and is the current product name; fsweb.fivestars.com is the legacy site. The original review's '70 million consumers and 12,000+ merchants' are 2021 acquisition-era figures, dropped. The 5STARS text-to-join keyword and the user-review criticism were not re-verified and were dropped. The $49 Connect Lite tier appears in the launch release and on FitGap but not on the current pricing page in search results; review wrote only the Plus and Pro prices. Gong cha story is on SumUp's site; Hwy 55 is an older press item; My Pie testimonial is on a SumUp landing page. 2026 updates are SumUp-wide, not Fivestars-specific; the April 2026 SumUp Loyalty launch is Europe-only. SumUp's loyalty and pricing pages fetched 2026-11. fsweb.fivestars.com (the link in the live review) no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN, 2026-11); www.fivestars.com redirects to the SumUp loyalty page used as the website. G2 rating (4.1 from 21 reviews) is for the legacy Fivestars listing; small sample, not cited in the review.
pros: Guests join with a phone number at checkout, with no card or app needed first
AutoPilot sends welcome, birthday and win-back texts automatically
'No complicated contracts' on SumUp's pricing page
Works with SumUp POS and many third-party POS systems
Cheaper bundled with SumUp POS ($199/month with Connect Plus)

cons.text: The current pricing page starts at $269 per month for Connect Plus ($199 bundled with SumUp POS)
Text-to-join, Review Boost and unlimited AI-enhanced messaging need Connect Pro; Connect Plus includes 2 standard promos per month
No free plan or trial listed on the pricing page
Built for independent cafes, quick-service restaurants and other local businesses, so multi-brand groups with their own app may need a different platform
